name: Opportunities
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of recognizing and wisely using the opportunities God provides for faithful service and readiness. The parables in Matthew 25:1, Luke 14:16, and Luke 19:12 illustrate the necessity of preparation and faithful stewardship while awaiting Christ’s return. Believers are encouraged in Galatians 6:10 to actively do good as opportunities arise, especially toward fellow believers, and Ephesians 5:16 exhorts Christians to redeem the time because the days are evil, highlighting the urgency of acting faithfully in the present.
